note: Game globals by name (SDK 16, hellforge_globals.h): cells in a module's data that hold a pointer to one of the game's objects (a manager, a queue), and the fields of that object the research has named. witnesses: 1 to 3 instructions of the game's code that load the cell (rva, and its bytes with the ones after it); the generator checks that each points at the cell, and the loader that one of them reads as reviewed before it hands the cell out (two, so a later patch over one of them does not lose the global). aliases: former names the loader still resolves (a renamed global keeps working for mods built with its old name; functions.json has them too). Offsets are from the start of the object. The loader resolves them only on this build: a new game build revalidates every entry.

Game.meaning: The Game: the session's top object, whose state the game's ChangeState (game.dll+0xAB2FA0) sets

wwise_world.meaning: the WwiseWorld: +0x4148 its default source (u32), heard everywhere

state.meaning: the game's state (HF_STATE_...; hf->game_state reads it)

level.meaning: the mission's level (the level generator, lg): +0xF9 its difficulty level (u8), +0x2C8 its generation block, +0x2D70 the playable radius / 1024 (f32)

Game.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-state; HellForge's HF_ON_STATE poll (event_sources.c)

PlayerManager.meaning: The players of the session. Per slot i (0 to count - 1): the peer id at +0x2C8 + 0x38 i (u64), its lifecycle at +0x2E0 + 0x38 i (u32: 2 waiting to respawn, 3 spawned), its player entity at [+0xE8 + 8 i] + 8 (u32), its Helldiver's network id at +0x3A8 + 0x20 i. Slots move as players leave: tell players apart by peer id
PlayerManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-mission; HellForge's HF_ON_PLAYER_SPAWN poll (event_sources.c)

host_peer.meaning: the game's host's peer id (it changes with a host migration)

LocalUser.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-mission; HellForge's local player (event_sources.c)

mission.meaning: the mission's data: +0x14 bit 0 set on the host, +8 the game mode's entity (u32)

GameMode.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-actions; HellForge's actions (actions.c ActMission)

EntityManager.meaning: The entities of this machine's world. At +0xF22EC8 a hash map of network ids to slots (8-byte keys, 4-byte values), and at +0xF32F20 the network objects by slot, 24 bytes each (+0 the entity id, u32); at +0xF1AEB0 the map of entity ids, at +0xF32F18 their descriptors
EntityManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's event polls (event_polls.c)

component_tables.meaning: component table 0; table c's pointer at +8 c: rows {u64 entity, u32 record, u32 0} from entity % slots, then the records

entity_deltas.meaning: the entity deltas a weapon's chosen attachments key into (by their add_path); reloaded at every use

entity_map.meaning: the entity map: 4096 rows of {u64 entity, u16* components, u64 component count, u32 short id, u32 0}, from entity % 4096

short_ids.meaning: the short ids: sorted {u32 short id, u32 map row}; an entity's index here is its type in the engine

HealthManager.meaning: Every entity's health. At +0x1030 a hash map of entity ids to indexes (8-byte keys, 4-byte values); an index's descriptor names its entity (+0 resource u64, +8 entity u32, +12 unit, +16 network id, +20 bit 0 owned here); its record holds health (i32) at +0x14 and its life (u32: 0 alive, 1 downed, 2 or more dead) at +0x19C; its ext record the maximum health (i32) at +0x14

descriptors.meaning: an array of descriptor pointers, by index

records.meaning: the health records, 0x1B8 bytes each, by index

ext.meaning: the ext records, 0x1C bytes each, by index

HealthManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's HF_ON_HEAL poll (event_polls.c) and heal (actions.c)

MotionManager.meaning: Entities that move. At +0x48A0 a hash map of entity ids to indexes (8-byte keys, 4-byte values); an index's descriptor names its entity at +8 (u32) and has bit 0 of +0x14 set while it is live; its record starts with its velocity (3 floats, m/s)

descriptors.meaning: an array of descriptor pointers, by index

records.meaning: the motion records, 0x84 bytes each, by index

positions.meaning: 0xA4 bytes per index: the position (3 floats) MoveObject writes

sources.meaning: 0x2C bytes per index: the position motion starts from each frame (3 floats; relative for an object riding a parent, the record's +0x3C not -1)

ExplosionQueue.meaning: The explosion requests of this frame: RequestExplosion's queue

count.meaning: requests queued (256 at most: RequestExplosion refuses more)

ProjectileSystem.meaning: The projectiles in flight: FireProjectile's system and the projectile pool
ProjectileSystem.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research projectile-ballistics; HellForge's spawn_projectile and shot rules (actions.c)

CombatQueues.meaning: This frame's damage and status requests, which the frame's drain applies (QueueDamage, QueueStatusRequest)
CombatQueues.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's injure and apply_status (actions.c)

ScoreManager.meaning: The players' mission stats. At +0x37D58 a map of player entities to indexes; the index's record at +0x37D98 + 0x28 index: a stat table, and 64 source blocks of 0x148 bytes at [record + 0x18], each a resource and 16 stat entries (HF_STAT_...)
ScoreManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-mission; HellForge's HF_ON_STAT poll (event_polls.c)

WielderManager.meaning: What entities hold. At +0x30 a map of entities to instances; an instance's slot 0 (its hand) at [+0x60] + 0x1D0 instance

slots.meaning: the instances' slots, 0x1D0 bytes per instance

WielderManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-wielder; HellForge's HF_ON_WEAPON poll (event_polls.c)

InventoryManager.meaning: The Helldivers' inventories. At +0x28 a map of entities to records; a record's inventory selection at +0x1C (u32: 1 primary, 2 secondary, 3 support, 4 or 5 a held item)
InventoryManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-wielder; HellForge's HF_ON_WEAPON poll (event_polls.c)

Destructibles.meaning: The world's destructible objects. Their descriptor pointers at +0x4030 and world indexes at +0x6030, one per destructible

index.meaning: the destructible index's holder: at +0x2C68 its table of 16-byte entries {u64 unit name, u64 the unit's destruction settings}, at +0x2C70 its capacity (u32, a power of two), probed from (i + 2 name) & (capacity - 1)

Destructibles.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-destruction; HellForge's HF_ON_BUGHOLE poll (event_polls.c)

DestructionRecords.meaning: The destruction state of the world's destructibles: records of 12 bytes at +0xC5F78 by world index (+0 unit, +7 stage u8, +8 bit 0 registered)
DestructionRecords.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-destruction; HellForge's HF_ON_BUGHOLE poll (event_polls.c)

slots.meaning: the record map's slots (0x8000 inline at +0x5F48)

slot_count.meaning: the record map's slots (a power of two; mask count - 1)

DepositManager.meaning: Entities that hand out supplies (a Supply Pack). At +0x20 a map of entities to deposits; at +0x60 a map of entities to definition overrides

amounts.meaning: 8 bytes per deposit: +0 the supplies left (u32)

definitions.meaning: the overriding definitions, 0x98 bytes each (+0x24 the self-use ability: 2629 for the B-1 Supply Pack)

ActionManager.meaning: The entities' actions. At +0xF8 a map of entities to indexes; descriptor pointers at +0x110 + 8 index (+8 the entity); each index's action context at +0x53E170 + 0x1238 index (+0 the entity, +8 the running action, TryStartAction's first argument) and its state flags at +0x53E880 and +0x53E888 (u64 each) of the same stride

WieldableManager.meaning: Wieldable items (weapons). At +0x18 a map of entities to indexes

wielders.meaning: the wielder of each index (u32 entity each)

WieldableManager.source: HellForge's credit_to_player (actions.c) and co-op shot swaps (shots.c)

FactionManager.meaning: The entities' factions. At +0x12050 a map of entities to indexes

masks.meaning: the faction mask of each index (u32 each; bit 0 the Helldivers' side)

BehaviourManager.meaning: The entities' behaviours. At +0x40 a map of entities to indexes

handles.meaning: a pointer per index: +8 the entity (u32), +0x10 its network handle (0x7FFF: none)

records.meaning: the behaviour records, 0x1F8 bytes each; P (record + 8) is a behaviour's state, P+0 its stage

TagManager.meaning: The entities' tag words. At +0x18 a map of entities to indexes

tags.meaning: the tag word of each index (u64 each): 0x10000000 its kills credited to no one, bit 35 never targeted

Clock.meaning: The game's clock, which behaviours time themselves by

EngineApi.meaning: The engine's API table (helldivers2.exe's), which the game calls into

table.meaning: its function table, in helldivers2.exe's data: at +1000 the text function, const char* (u32 id), which HellForge points at its own to answer mod texts

scene_graph.meaning: the scene graph's functions: +0x88 a node's world position (unit, node), +0x748 the unit of an index

EngineApi.source: HellForge's Pelican turret (behaviour_turret.c) and ability sounds (abilities.c); HellForge's mod text (registry.c HookText)

EngineUnitApi.meaning: An engine API table in helldivers2.exe (helldivers2.exe+0x27CD4C0 on this build)

actor_by_name.meaning: UnitActorByName (helldivers2.exe 0x799DE0): (unit, actor name hash, NULL) -> the actor, 0xFFFFFFFF none

WwiseApi.meaning: The Wwise plugin's API table; its functions take the WwiseWorld (hf_global_Game's wwise_world)

post.meaning: posts a sound: (world, event, game object, flags)

unit_source.meaning: the source on a unit's node: (world, unit, node)

source_object.meaning: a source's game object: (world, source), -1 when the source is gone

AbilityManager.meaning: The abilities running on entities: StartAbility's first argument. At +0x18 a map of entities to indexes; it ticks each ability at 60 a second (AbilityTick)
AbilityManager.source: HellForge's silo countdown (abilities.c) and shield wall (shield_block.c)

WeaponLinkerManager.meaning: WeaponLinker instances (a silo's targeting remote linked to its missile and rack). At +0x20 a map of entities to indexes; its copies of the records of instances this machine has authority over (12 bytes each) are compacted when one goes

descriptors.meaning: a descriptor pointer per index (LinkerRecord's argument)

SeekingMissileManager.meaning: Seeking missiles (a silo's). At +0x20 a map of entities to indexes

rows.meaning: 0xC0 bytes per index: +0x48 the missile's position (3 floats)

instances.meaning: 0x38 bytes per index: +8 its remote's network handle, +0xC its guidance target, +0x35 engine byte, +0x36 launched byte

SeekingMissileManager.source: HellForge's silo countdown (abilities.c) and co-op diagnostics (coop_diag.c)

LaserDesignatorManager.meaning: Laser designators (a silo remote's laser). At +0x30 a map of entities to indexes

instances.meaning: 0x38 bytes per index: +0x2C the marked point (3 floats)

on.meaning: a byte per index: the laser on

GuidanceTargets.meaning: Guided entities' targets (SetGuidanceTarget). At +0x840 a map of entities to indexes

ExplosiveManager.meaning: Explosives (SetExplosiveOwner's first argument). At +0x38 a map of entities to indexes

RemoteOwners.meaning: The owner of a silo's targeting remote. At +0x20 a map of entities to indexes

records.meaning: 48 bytes per index: +4 the owner entity

HellpodRackManager.meaning: Hellpod racks (RackReleaseItem's first argument). At +0x28 a map of entities to indexes

AttachableManager.meaning: Attachables (what sits in someone's hands). At +0x18 a map of entities to indexes; records of 0xAC bytes (+0 the holder's link)

MountManager.meaning: Mounts (a Pelican's turret). At +0x20 a map of entities to indexes

records.meaning: 6 u32 per index: the mounted children 0 to 4 first

DropAnchors.meaning: Drop positions (a transport Pelican's beacon). At +0x30 a map of entities to indexes

PerceptionManager.meaning: Perceivers and what they sense (FindPerceptionEntry's first argument). At +0x30 a map of entities to indexes

MagazineRefills.meaning: The magazines AddMagazineRounds refills. At +0x20 a map of entities to indexes (the refill's own lookup)

WeaponTargeting.meaning: Weapons' targeting. At +0x150 a map of entities to indexes

ShieldManager.meaning: The shields standing (relay bubbles, shield packs): a map of 8-byte entries {key, index} (index 0xFFFFFFFF: none) and, per index, a binding, a row and a live state

empty.meaning: the key of an empty entry

bindings.meaning: a binding pointer per index (ShieldRecord's argument)

rows.meaning: 0x88 bytes per index: +0 the physics handle

CustomizationManager.meaning: The players' armor and its passives. At +0x30 the passive ids' slots (u32 each, 42 ids); at +0x930 a map of entities to records, their descriptor pointers at +0x948; per record an applied block at +0x96C + 0x44 record (+0x38 the helmet passive, +0x3C the armor passive). Kit records: the kit id at +0 (u32), its type at +0x28 (u32: 0 armour, 1 helmet, 2 cape)

kits.meaning: the armor kits (a kit row's +0x1C its passive)

passives.meaning: pointers to the passive rows (0x34 bytes each), by slot

record_count.meaning: records in use (at most 4, one a player)

CustomizationManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research player-attributes; HellForge's set_passives and armor perks (passives.c, perks.c); HellForge's warbond showcase (warbond_showcase.c WarbondItemKit)

BombardmentManager.meaning: Bombardments (an orbital barrage). At +0x30 a map of entities to indexes, filled within the spawn

blocks.meaning: 0x1C bytes per index: +0 shells a salvo, +4 salvos, +8 the target, +0x14 heading, +0x18 seed

Progression.meaning: The progression manager: this machine's player's account (catalogue, warbonds, purchases). Its purchased warbond items from +0xD8A5C (u32 ids). HellForge moves its warbond list and catalogue elsewhere when mods add warbonds, so do not read those from it. The player's progression: the item catalogue and inventory in one table (a part of the game state, which HellForge enlarges: its catalogue moves past the state's old end, state_moves.c). As the game has it: a count at +0x1CE0, 0xB8-byte records from +0x1CE4 (+4 mixId, +8 itemId, +0xC category, +0xB0 amount)

bought_count.meaning: warbond items purchased (5280 at most), their ids following

login.meaning: the login's state: 12 once logged in

pending_buy.meaning: nonzero while a warbond buy waits for its reply

Progression.source: HellForge's warbonds (warbonds.c) and loadout scrub (loadout_scrub.c); KB hellforge-live-mod-sync-re-content; HellForge's live-added items (ownership.c, state_moves.c)

PlayerHistory.meaning: The players' loadouts. Records of 0x1690 bytes from +0: the peer id at +0 (u64), the loadout at +0x38 (stratagem slots of 0x30 bytes at +0x188 with the type at +0, their count at +0x788), its loaded copy at +0xA28 (load type +0x9E4: 2 for a mission). Loadouts of players who left at +0x2FD10 (0x9F0 each); the shared stratagems at +0x45410 (64 of 0x6C: {type, choice, state})

left_count.meaning: loadouts kept for players who left

Profile.meaning: This machine's player's saved loadout. At +0x4C 32 {stratagem stable id, uses} pairs (u32 each)

MenuStates.meaning: The UI state machine. Its state stack: 5 u32 from +0x429C, the top at +0x429C + 4 (depth - 1) (5 the Armory, 14 the mission briefing's loadout). Its presenter (+0x4294) is 0 while no menu is open

presenter.meaning: the menu presenter open (14 the loadout screen)

MenuStates.source: HellForge's loadout scrub (loadout_scrub.c) and armory diagnostics (armory_diag.c); HellForge's live level 11 (difficulty.c, DifficultyCapTick)

top.meaning: the menu on top (11 the loadout screen)

Armory.meaning: The armory's list (BuildArmoryList's, or HellForge's larger copy when mods add weapons): 32-byte entries, the loadout id at +0 and the entity at +8 (u64). Type t's entries start at entry [+0x1B24 + 4 t] and number [+0x1B40 + 4 t] (u32; 7 types, 1 primary, 2 support, 3 secondary)

starts.meaning: type 0's first entry; type t's at +4 t

counts.meaning: type 0's entries; type t's at +4 t

Armory.source: HellForge's weapon registry (registry.c, registry_load.c) and warbond showcase (warbond_showcase.c)

ThumbnailManager.meaning: The Armory's thumbnail manager: six cards of up to 15 icon requests rendered into one atlas. Card c's state at +1832 + 1816 c (u32, 8 complete), its request count at +1836 + 1816 c, its requests of 120 bytes from +32 + 1816 c (+24 the item's id, +100 its kind 0 weapon to 4 cape, +104 its stage: 1 waiting, 2 submitted, 3 unit available, 4 done)

PackageSystem.meaning: The RefcountedPackageSystem: RequestPackages' system. Its reference map has 16-byte entries keyed by package id (u64, 0 empty) and no overflow path

GameConfig.meaning: The game's config settings: FindConfigSetting's config. Two open-addressing tables of 48-byte entries, the online overrides at +0x12078 and the defaults at +0xC050 (each {entries, capacity +8, empty key +0xC, multiplier +0x10}; an entry's type at +0x14, its value at +0x18)

NavigationSystem.meaning: The engine's navigation interface, a table of functions: its +8 sets up a nav world's navmesh grid (ecx the nav world's id), called for each mission's level (setup_navmeshgrid, pass 0x68) and for the ship

PhysicsPlugin.meaning: Set by the physics plugin setup's first call (SetupPhysicsConfig, once per process): 0 until the engine's physics pools are set up

ObjectiveManager.meaning: The mission's objective instances, which the HUD's objective updater (UpdateHudObjectives) numbers

HiveMindManager.meaning: The mission's HiveMind: the enemy director and the mission's countdowns. The mission's countdowns. With one timer, its slot at +0x51948: +4 a byte set once it has run out, +6 its pause byte (1 paused), which the countdown's update honours; hf->freeze_mission_timer writes it, host only

level.meaning: the mission's level (lg): its difficulty level at +0xF9 (u8)

director.meaning: the timer's director: +8 the game mode's entity (u32)

expired.meaning: set once the timer has run out

HiveMindManager.source: HellForge's mission countdown (difficulty_countdown.c, kWidgetTimeStub); HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research mission-timer; HellForge's freeze_mission_timer (actions.c)

Telemetry.meaning: The game's telemetry: the mission-end telemetry record (TelemetryMissionEnd) at +0x31820 keeps 16 objective instances

GuardForces.meaning: The mission's outposts (GuardForce records). A record (0x2B8 bytes): +0x2A8 its size (1 small, 2 medium, 3 large, 4 stronghold), +0x2AB whether it is active
